preparation: Source frames 0 through 125 forward, then frames 124 through 1 in reverse: 250 frames / 10 s. The first and last source samples are adjacent rather than repeated, making the wrap a continuous one-frame step. Center crop 1080×1920 removes 64 pixels at each vertical edge, then Lanczos scales to 720×1280. Silent OpenH264 high-profile MP4, GOP 25, faststart, no baked visual treatment.
preparationCommand: nice -n 10 ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -threads 1 -i pexels-6809877-hd_1080_2048_25fps.mp4 -filter_complex_threads 1 -filter_complex '[0:v]trim=start_frame=0:end_frame=126,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,crop=1080:1920:0:64,scale=720:1280:flags=lanczos,setsar=1,split=2[f][r];[r]reverse,trim=start_frame=1:end_frame=125,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[b];[f][b]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[out]' -map '[out]' -an -c:v libopenh264 -profile:v high -b:v 3500k -maxrate 4000k -rc_mode bitrate -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 -r 25 -video_track_timescale 25 -g 25 -movflags +faststart -map_metadata -1 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 second-skin-dancer.mp4
